metadata.description: Skills packaged as autonomous agents for Amazon seller operations.

plugins.name: amazon-creative-studio
plugins.description: Design agent (AMZ-DESIGN): carousel, A+, Brand Story, Store, ads creatives, video; briefs, prompts, production XLSX, preflight, image reading.

plugins.name: amazon-seo-listings
plugins.description: SEO & Listings agent: product data, claims, SEO content (Cerebro / Helium 10), localized listing text, pricing and margin, sealed package for the Feeds agent.

plugins.name: amazon-ppc
plugins.description: PPC agent: campaign build, search term analysis, harvest and negatives, bids / budgets / placements, ACOS-TACOS-ROAS from real margins, diagnosis and reviews.

plugins.name: amazon-feeds
plugins.description: Feeds agent: fill feed templates (Template rows 7+ only), analyze feed errors from Processing Reports, apply approved corrections with QA and re-analysis.
